title: 외래어 3: 파일, 비디오, 라디오 읽기
objective: Read and say loanwords like 파일, 비디오 and 라디오.
summary: Learn how Korean writes f, v, r, l and th in loanwords.

task.title: Read and write loanwords
task.line: Use the four rules on page 1 to choose, fill in or match each word.

words.exampleMeaning: I listen to the radio in the car.
I watch TV in the evening.
I work out at the gym every day.

letters.sound: Korean has no f. It is written ㅍ [p], said with a puff of air.
Korean has no v. It is written ㅂ [b]. Close the lips; do not touch your teeth.
Both become ㄹ. An l between vowels is written ㄹㄹ [ll]; an r between vowels is one ㄹ.
The th in 'think' is written ㅅ [s]. The th in 'this' is written ㄷ.

exercises: Choose the correct spelling: ① fork (포크 / 보크) ② violin (바이올린 / 파이올린) ③ lemon (레몬 / 네몬)
Fill in the blank with 파, 비, or 리: ① 소__ (sofa) ② 서__스 (service) ③ 갤러__ (gallery)
Choose the correct spelling. Remember: l between vowels is ㄹㄹ, and r between vowels is one ㄹ. ① 콜라 / 코라 (cola) ② 카레 / 칼레 (curry) ③ 멜론 / 메론 (melon)
Match each Korean word to its English word (fan, visa, thrill): ① 비자 ② 팬 ③ 스릴
answers: ① 포크 ② 바이올린 ③ 레몬
① 파 (소파) ② 비 (서비스) ③ 리 (갤러리)
① 콜라 ② 카레 ③ 멜론
① visa ② fan ③ thrill
